Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Wed, Oct 28 7:20am to 6:31pm; Thu, Oct 29 7:22am to 6:29pm; Fri, Oct 30 7:23am to 6:28pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Wed, Oct 28 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Quiet, grey one after last night’s southerly. At 5am Pam Rocks reads NNE 7, the English Bay buoy ENE 6 and Pemberton is level with Vancouver. Nothing on the page tops 30%.

If you need a session, my best guess is Tsawwassen, south side, from 5pm to last light around 6:20, SE 8 to 10. Tide is 13 to 14ft, so plenty of water. Environment Canada has east 10 to 15 late, ahead of the page. Go if Sand Heads swings SE and reads 12+ by 4pm.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:00 PM PCT 28 October 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Thursday. Gale warning in effect. Wind light increasing to northerly outflow 15 to 25 knots early this evening and to northerly outflow 25 to 35 late overnight. Wind diminishing to northerly outflow 20 near noon Thursday then increasing to northerly outflow 25 to 35 Thursday evening.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 PM PCT 28 October 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Thursday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind southeast 5 to 15 knots increasing to east 15 to 25 after midnight then becoming easterly 15 early Thursday afternoon.
